title: Characterization of NC
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ belongs to $\mathrm{NC}$ if and only if there is an integer $i\ge 1$ and a circuit family recognizing exactly $L$ such that every circuit has fan-in at most two, the family has polynomial size, and its depth is bounded by a polynomial in $\log n+1$ of degree $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
